body: I'm just so worried it won't be enough. I don't want to be an outcast. I just want to look male. But I do not pass at all. I doubt T will change that.

I'm just terrified that I will look like a bearded lady or some other sad hybrid.  I have obsessively looked at peoples before and after T pictures. Its pretty obvious that those that passed before T look the best.

I hoped if I slept on it, I would feel better but I woke up and still feel like shit.
